notes: One standing invitation per party, or none. `empty` is none — a party who has never published one, which is where story 10 path E starts and is the ordinary state

`creditLimit: 0` is the point of the thing (story 10 path E, story 21 path A): strangers are offered no credit, and whoever takes it up funds the tally themselves. It is still useful — they hand over value, it is recorded, and they spend it from there

`takenUp` is one entry per responder, each naming its own tally. Story 01 path C.4: they are separate relationships from the moment they open, and any of them can be negotiated individually afterward — which is why the tally's terms today need not match what was published
`disclose` goes to every responder, known and unknown. Story 11 path C calls that effectively public, and the party has to be told so before publishing rather than after
There is no error fixture. Publishing failing is the same failure as sharing an ordinary invitation, which `CreateInvitation` already carries
